title: Livestock Treatment Request Form
subtitle: Livestock Treatment: defines need, constraints, and assignment.
description: Livestock Treatment Request Form covers animal or group, condition, product, dose, route, withdrawal interval, response, and disposition. The livestock care record owner records Livestock Treatment need, timing, access, and assignment. Livestock Treatment Request Form keeps Livestock Treatment exceptions visible until the livestock care record owner handoff.
use_case: Use Livestock Treatment Request Form at pen, pasture, barn, treatment area, and product storage location. Document animal or group, condition, product, dose, route, withdrawal interval, response, and disposition identity before Livestock Treatment begins. Compare animal or group, condition, product, dose, route, withdrawal interval, response, and disposition findings with stated Livestock Treatment criteria; route unresolved Livestock Treatment issues to veterinary or otherwise qualified treatment reviewer. For Livestock Treatment Request Form, confirm requirements for Livestock Treatment. Ask veterinary or otherwise qualified treatment reviewer to review Livestock Treatment conditions beyond the livestock care record owner's role.

sections.title: Requester, location, and subject details
sections.guidance: For Livestock Treatment, identify responsible parties, pen, pasture, barn, treatment area, and product storage location, and the linked animal or group, condition, product, dose, route, withdrawal interval, response, and disposition source.

sections.guidance: Resolve open Livestock Treatment request questions; have livestock care record owner record the assignment, response owner, and requester follow-up while keeping the record strictly at the intake and routing stage.

blocks.guidance: Do not assign or authorize the Livestock Treatment request when animal identity, treatment authority, dose, adverse response, withdrawal, or qualified disposition remains unresolved. Retain information supplied with the request and route unresolved constraints to livestock care record owner.
